# pkg_regex: # majors = installed SDK majors the entry applies to. kind: removed | renamed | inert | deprecated | changed-default | platform-gated. when: optional unit predicate (platform:macos, role:library ...).

name: sendDefaultPii
message: Replaced by dataCollection. Behavior change: an UNSET dataCollection collects everything in v11 (user info, cookies, headers, request/response bodies, AI inputs/outputs). Set dataCollection explicitly from the privacy policy.

name: enableLogs
message: Removed (TS2353 on 11.x). Logs are captured whenever Sentry.logger.* is used or a logging integration such as consoleLoggingIntegration() is added. Delete the option.

name: enableMetrics
message: Removed, including the _experiments variant. Metrics are captured when Sentry.metrics.* is used; beforeSendMetric is a top-level option now.

name: beforeSendTransaction
message: Span streaming is the v11 default, so no transaction events exist and this hook never runs. Use beforeSendSpan (guard on is_segment) or set traceLifecycle: 'static' to keep transactions.

name: ignoreTransactions
message: No transactions in stream mode. Use ignoreSpans (object form to target one op) or traceLifecycle: 'static'.

name: profilesSampleRate
message: Legacy per-transaction profiling option removed in v11 (browser and Node). Use profileSessionSampleRate with profileLifecycle 'trace' or 'manual'.

name: disableInstrumentationWarnings
message: Removed; the SDK can no longer detect a framework imported before Sentry.init().

name: addVercelAiProcessors
message: Add vercelAIIntegration() instead.

name: enableTruncation
message: Gen AI spans are always streamed and never truncated.

name: streamGenAiSpans
message: Gen AI spans are always streamed.

name: ignorePerformanceApiSpans
message: Use userTimingIntegration({ ignore: [...] }).

name: trackFetchStreamPerformance
message: Use fetchStreamPerformanceIntegration().

name: enableInp
message: Use browserTracingIntegration({ webVitals: { ignore: ['inp'] } }).

name: inboundFiltersIntegration
message: The export was removed; the integration reports itself as EventFilters. Filter by name 'EventFilters'.

name: registerEsmLoaderHooks
message: The SDK no longer registers import-in-the-middle loader hooks. --import your instrument file instead.

name: honoIntegration
message: Use the @sentry/hono SDK.

name: setupExpressErrorHandler
message: Express errors are captured automatically in v11; the call is no longer needed (removal planned for v12).

name: setupFastifyErrorHandler
message: Fastify errors are captured automatically in v11; remove the call to avoid duplicates.

name: trackIncomingRequestsAsSessions
message: httpIntegration option renamed to sessions.

name: maxIncomingRequestBodySize
message: httpIntegration option renamed to maxRequestBodySize.

name: dropSpansForIncomingRequestStatusCodes
message: httpIntegration option renamed to ignoreStatusCodes (only effective with traceLifecycle: 'static').

name: otlpIntegration
message: Renamed to openTelemetryIntegration().

name: hideSourceMaps
message: Removed in v9: source maps are hidden by default and deleted after upload.

name: autoInstrumentServerFunctions
message: Deprecated since 10.30.0 and removed in v11; use webpack.autoInstrumentServerFunctions.

name: autoInstrumentMiddleware
message: Use webpack.autoInstrumentMiddleware.

name: autoInstrumentAppDirectory
message: Use webpack.autoInstrumentAppDirectory.

name: automaticVercelMonitors
message: Use webpack.automaticVercelMonitors.

name: excludeServerRoutes
message: Use webpack.excludeServerRoutes.

name: disableLogger
message: Deprecated since 10.30.0 and removed in v11; Use webpack.treeshake.removeDebugLogging (Turbopack ignores webpack.* options).

name: disableManifestInjection
message: Deprecated since 10.30.0 and removed in v11; Use routeManifestInjection: false.

name: unstable_sentryWebpackPluginOptions
message: Set the plugin options as first-class build options instead.

name: @sentry/nextjs/config
message: In v11 import withSentryConfig from '@sentry/nextjs/config', not '@sentry/nextjs'.

name: enableTracing
message: Removed in v9. Set tracesSampleRate (or a tracesSampler) instead.

name: autoSessionTracking
message: Removed in v9. Session tracking comes from browserSessionIntegration (browser) or httpIntegration (server), both on by default.

name: getCurrentHub
message: Hub APIs were removed in v9. Use getCurrentScope()/getIsolationScope()/getClient().

name: debugIntegration
message: Removed in v9. Log outgoing events from beforeSend hooks.

name: sessionTimingIntegration
message: Removed in v9. Use Sentry.setContext().

name: captureUserFeedback
message: Removed in v9. Use captureFeedback and rename the comments field to message.

name: hasTracingEnabled
message: Removed in v10. Use hasSpansEnabled.

name: BaseClient
message: Removed in v10. Use Client.

name: startTransaction
message: Removed in v8. Use startSpan / startSpanManual / startInactiveSpan.

name: configureScope
message: Removed in v8. Use getCurrentScope().

name: profilesSampler
message: Legacy per-transaction profiling option removed in v11 (Node). Use profileSessionSampleRate with profileLifecycle.
